meta.title: Lease Loop – catalogue
meta.description: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine. When the lease ends, it gets a second life.
brand.name: Lease Loop
brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines
catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.intro: Every item can be leased, returned, refurbished and leased again.
catalogue.empty: No assets in the database yet. Run npm run db:setup and reload.
filter.priceInvalid: A price must be an amount in euros, like 1500 or 1500,50. It was ignored.
condition.label: Condition
status.label: Status
contract.totalLeaseNet: Total lease cost (down + rents, excl. VAT)
contract.totalWithBuyoutNet: Total if bought at end (excl. VAT)
contract.priceLockNote: Signing locks the net monthly rent ({netRent}) on {date}. VAT follows each invoice date's rate.
contract.signedBannerBody: Locked net monthly rent: {netRent} (price list v{version}, {months} months, down payment {downPayment}).
contract.errorNoPrice: This item has no valid list price on {date} and cannot be leased right now.
contract.errorUnavailable: This item is currently {status} and cannot be signed into a new lease.
contract.errorBelowMinimum: Financed amount ({amount}) is below the minimum financeable amount ({min}).
contract.errorAboveMaximum: Financed amount ({amount}) exceeds the maximum financeable amount ({max}).
contract.errorInvalidQuote: This lease configuration cannot be financed.
invoices.title: Monthly invoice schedule
invoices.intro: Each monthly invoice locks the agreed net rent ({netRent}). VAT is calculated according to the statutory rate in effect on each invoice's due date.
invoices.pageIntro: Your lease contract is signed and the monthly net rent is locked for the full term.
invoices.bill.heading: Lease invoice
invoices.bill.vatChangeNote: Statutory VAT changed from {signingRate}% (at signing) to {currentRate}% on {dueDate}. Your net monthly rent ({netRent}) remains locked.
invoices.endOfTerm.heading: End-of-lease options
invoices.endOfTerm.subheading: At the end of your lease, choose to buy the asset, return it to Lease Loop, or pass it on to a waiting user.
invoices.endOfTerm.buy.title: Buy it
invoices.endOfTerm.buy.description: Purchase and keep your leased equipment for the contractual buyout price.
invoices.endOfTerm.buy.dialogIntro: Exercise your contractual buyout option to acquire full ownership.
invoices.endOfTerm.buy.successMessage: Asset purchased! Full ownership has been transferred to you.
invoices.endOfTerm.return.title: Return it
invoices.endOfTerm.return.description: Return the equipment to Lease Loop. No buyout fee; equipment undergoes standard return inspection.
invoices.endOfTerm.return.dialogIntro: End your lease and schedule equipment return.
invoices.endOfTerm.return.checklistItem1: Ensure equipment is clean and undamaged beyond normal wear and tear.
invoices.endOfTerm.return.checklistItem2: Factory reset digital devices and remove personal accounts.
invoices.endOfTerm.return.checklistItem3: Include original charging cables and accessories.
invoices.endOfTerm.return.inspectionNoti: Final return status confirmed upon arrival and technical inspection.
invoices.endOfTerm.return.successMessage: Return scheduled! The asset is registered for return inspection.
invoices.endOfTerm.passOn.title: Pass your lease on
invoices.endOfTerm.passOn.description: Hand your equipment over to someone waiting on the second-life list, saving CO₂ and closing the loop.
invoices.endOfTerm.passOn.dialogTitle: Pass your lease on to Second Life
invoices.endOfTerm.passOn.dialogIntro: Connect your equipment directly to someone waiting for a pre-owned lease.
invoices.endOfTerm.passOn.noMatchNotice: No immediate waitlist candidate. Item will be prepared for public catalogue relisting.
invoices.endOfTerm.passOn.successMessage: Passed on to Second Life! Avoiding {co2} kg CO₂ manufacturing emissions.
apply.title: Apply for a lease
apply.intro: Answer a few questions. We only ask what we need for this lease.
apply.deal.heading: Your lease
apply.questions.heading: Your details
apply.money.hint: Amount in euros, for example 2500 or 2500,50
apply.money.invalid: Enter an amount in euros, for example 2500 or 2500,50.
apply.date.invalid: Enter a real date as day/month/year, for example 31/12/1990.
apply.dropped: We removed answers that no longer apply:
apply.error: We could not check your answers. Try again in a moment.
apply.notFound: We could not find that item.
apply.invalidDeal: This lease is not valid. Pick an item, a term and a down payment again.
apply.unavailable: This item cannot be leased right now.
apply.signError: We could not sign the contract right now. Please try again.
decision.heading: Result
decision.incomplete.title: Keep going
decision.yes.title: Approved
decision.yes.body: You meet all the requirements for this lease.
decision.no.title: We can't offer this lease
decision.manual_review.title: A person will check your application
decision.manual_review.body: We can't approve this automatically. Here is why:
reason.min_age: You need to be {minimum} to sign a lease, and you are {age} for now. Come back when you turn {minimum}, or ask a parent or guardian to apply instead.
reason.residency: We only lease to people who live in Finland, Sweden or Estonia.
reason.affordability: The monthly rent of {rent} is more than 30 % of your monthly net income ({income}). A longer term or a bigger down payment may help.
reason.business_id: The business ID {answer} is not valid. Check the number, including the digit after the dash.
reason.financed_limits.below_minimum: The financed amount is below the smallest amount we finance. Choose a smaller down payment or a pricier item.
reason.financed_limits.above_maximum: The financed amount is above the largest amount we finance. Choose a bigger down payment.
reason.financed_limits.unknown_term: This term is not available for this financed amount.
reason.pep_manual_review: Anti-money-laundering rules require a person to check every application from a politically exposed person.
reason.signatory_required: The person applying must be allowed to sign for the company. A person will contact the colleague who can sign.
reason.blocked_answer: One of your answers means we cannot offer this lease.
invoices.earlyExit.heading: Ending the lease early
invoices.earlyExit.subheading: Pick the month you would leave and see exactly what it costs, line by line.
invoices.earlyExit.conditionHint: A return is priced from the inspection when the item comes back: its condition and its usage reading. They start from the record at the start of the lease and can only get worse.
invoices.earlyExit.inspectionInvalid.usa: The reading cannot be below {recorded}, the reading at the start of the lease. Showing the price for the recorded reading.
invoices.earlyExit.inspectionInvalid.con: The item cannot come back in better condition than it left in ({recorded}). Showing the price for the recorded condition.
invoices.earlyExit.inspectionInvalid.inv: The reading must be a whole, non-negative number. Showing the price for the recorded reading.
invoices.earlyExit.summary: {billed} monthly rents are billed by {date} and {remaining} are still to come. VAT is charged at the rate on that date ({vat}%).
invoices.earlyExit.owedExplain: What you still owe is the remaining rents plus the end-of-term buyout, with the interest for months you will not use taken out (interest rate {rate}% a year).
invoices.earlyExit.termOver: All rents are billed: this is the normal end-of-term buyout, and returning the item costs nothing.
invoices.earlyExit.buyout.title: Buy it out now
invoices.earlyExit.buyout.description: Pay what is still owed and keep the item.
invoices.earlyExit.return.title: Return it now
invoices.earlyExit.return.description: Give the item back. Its market value, less the refurbishment it needs before its next lease, is credited against what you owe.
invoices.earlyExit.line.interestNotCharg: Interest not charged for months you will not use ({rate}% a year)
invoices.earlyExit.line.returnCredit: Market value of the returned item ({months} months, {usage})
invoices.earlyExit.line.returnAdjustment: Raised to zero: the item is worth more than you owe
Capped at the rents still to come
invoices.earlyExit.marketValue: Market value after {months} months: {price} first list price × {percent}% on the value curve, adjusted for condition ({condition}) and usage ({usage}) = {value}. Refurbishment needed before the next lease: {refurbishment}.
invoices.earlyExit.action.needsInspectio: A return needs the inspection: enter who inspected the item, then recalculate.
invoices.earlyExit.action.doneBuyout: Done. The lease ended on {date} and the item is now yours. Your final invoice is {amount}.
invoices.earlyExit.action.doneReturn: Done. The lease ended on {date}. Please bring the item back. Your final invoice is {amount}.
invoices.earlyExit.action.ended: This lease has already ended, so there is nothing more to pay here.
invoices.earlyExit.action.error: Something went wrong and nothing was changed. Please try again.
